english:
<strand Strand /> Weapon Kills spawn a <strand Tangle /> at the enemy's death location while on a <strand Strand /> Subclass.

Spawning a Tangle this way triggers the global Tangle cooldown.

source.text:
While on a Strand Subclass:

Strand Weapon Kills spawn a Tangle on Enemy Death Location.
Triggers the global Tangle cooldown.
